title: Figure: one branch per tool that uses this mechanic. A spec's data must match at least one branch.
description: Merged as anyOf branches (kit 0.2.0). Branches: c14-05, framework-strip, ed007-figure-01, ed007-figure-02, ed007-figure-03, ed007-figure-04, ed007-figure-05, ed007-figure-06. The validator's schema-lite reports the first error of each branch when none match.

anyOf.title: c14-05
anyOf.description: c14-05 (built/htw/c14-05, schema file mechanic-figure-1.json, id mechanic/figure/1). Figure (record card): examples shown whole with a caption, a field table and a note form (c14-05 seven fields). Proposed for kit/schema/mechanics/figure-1.json; it is kept beside the tool because tool folders may not edit kit/. If Edition 007 figures need figure-1 for another shape, rename this one record-1 and set mechanic to record.

anyOf.title: framework-strip
anyOf.description: framework-strip (built/main/framework-strip, schema file data.schema.json, id mechanic/figure-strip/1). Figure, four-cell strip with a photograph, a question and a link in each cell (X3 Framework strip). Proposed as an anyOf branch of kit/schema/mechanics/figure-1.json; the kit has no file for it yet.
